author: Written by Claude (Anthropic) directly as weights, as a first guess before training.
notes: From the first rows: dry soil means 'water' (label 1), wet soil means 'wait' (label 0). My first guess is a cut-off at 30% soil moisture. Hidden unit 0 = relu(30 - moisture): how much drier than 30% the soil is. Hidden unit 1 = relu(moisture - 30): how much wetter. Output 'wait' = hidden 1, output 'water' = hidden 0. I suspect heat dries plants faster and so moves the cut-off, but I couldn't read the exact effect from the rows, so temperature and hours start at 0 and training gets to find them.
